delete_account_intro: Deletion is reversible for 7 days. After that, your profile, messages and other personal data are anonymised and cannot be restored.
delete_account_warning: This will revoke all API keys and push subscriptions immediately. After 7 days your account is permanently anonymised. Type your email to confirm.
delete_account_pending_banner: Your account is scheduled for deletion on {{date}}.
delete_account_pending_intro: Your account is scheduled for permanent deletion on {{date}}. Until then you can cancel below.
delete_account_full_lockout_body: Most of the app is locked while your account is scheduled for deletion. Cancel below to regain access, or sign out.
data_export_intro: Get a ZIP archive of your profile, messages, conversations, reactions, moderation history and notifications. Attachment files are referenced by signed URLs valid for 7 days.
data_export_status_queued: Queued — your archive will be ready shortly.
data_export_status_ready_intro: Your archive is ready ({{size}}). Download expires {{date}}.
data_export_status_failed: Archive generation failed. Try again in 24 hours.
data_export_cooldown_hint: You can request another export 24 hours after your previous request.
api_keys_intro: Personal Access Tokens give scripts and bots programmatic access to your account, with the scopes you choose.
api_key_admin_warning: Admin scope grants full server access to anyone holding the key. Use sparingly.
api_key_token_shown_once_warning: This is the only time you'll see this token. Store it somewhere safe — you can't recover it later.
api_key_revoke_confirm: Revoke {{name}}? Any scripts using this key will stop working.
notifications_unavailable: Notification options are not available in this browser.
skin_tone_hint: Default tone for emoji that support skin variations.
noise_suppression_hint: Reduces steady background noise from your microphone (browser-native).
background_blur_hint: Blurs your camera background during video calls. Needs a reasonably fast device.
mirror_self_hint: Shows your own camera mirrored, like a mirror. Others always see you un-mirrored.
devices_hint: Device names appear after you grant microphone access (e.g. after joining a voice channel).
email_notifications_hint: Once a day, get an email listing personal mentions and direct messages you missed. Off by default.
desktop_notifications_hint: Show system pop-ups for mentions and messages while the app is in the background.
desktop_notifications_blocked: Notifications are blocked in your browser settings. Allow them there to enable this.
notif_levels_pointer: Set per channel from the bell icon in the channel list.
send_typing_indicator: Let others see when I'm typing
send_typing_indicator_hint: When off, no one is shown a "typing…" cue from you.
convert_emoticons_hint: Turns text emoticons like :) <3 ;) into emoji as you type. Skipped inside code.
resume_last_location: Pick up where you left off
resume_last_location_hint: Reopen the channel or conversation you last viewed when you come back. Turn off to land on the community default channel.
name_update_failed: Failed to update name. Please try again.
profile_update_failed: Failed to update profile. Please try again.
avatar_upload_failed: Failed to upload avatar. Please try again.
avatar_remove_failed: Failed to remove avatar. Please try again.
image_too_large: Image must be smaller than 1 MB.
image_too_small: Image must be at least 100×100 pixels.
image_too_big_dimensions: Image must be at most 1000×1000 pixels.
two_factor_off_hint: Add a second sign-in step with an authenticator app.
two_factor_scan_qr: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app (e.g. Aegis, Google Authenticator, 1Password).
two_factor_setup_failed: Could not start two-factor setup. Try again later.
two_factor_verify_hint: Enter the 6-digit code your app shows to finish.
two_factor_confirm_failed: That code didn't match. Check your app and try again.
two_factor_codes_warning: Save these recovery codes now — they are shown only once. Each unlocks your account once if you lose your authenticator.
two_factor_disable_hint: Your account will no longer require a code at sign-in. Recovery codes are deleted.
two_factor_regenerate_hint: Your current recovery codes will stop working.
